newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch 1996 cash retail sales rise 3.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dutch 1996 cash retail sales rise 3.2 pct.

text.p: Dutch retail sales rose 3.2 percent in cash terms in 1996 compared with 1995, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Friday.
December figures on an annual basis will be available later, the Central Bureau of Statistics said.
In volume terms, 1996 retail sales were 3.2 percent higher than in 1995, the CBS said, adding prices were unchanged.
NOTES - A CBS spokesman said the full-year 1996 figures had a provisional character and that separate December figures were expected to be published in the coming weeks.
The CBS noted that the 3.2 percent rise in the cash value of retail sales in 1996 was the biggest since 1991 when cash retail sales rose 4.4 percent.
In 1995 cash retail sales rose 1.2 percent compared with the previous year while in 1994 they rose 0.7 percent.
